title: PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) Clipped Loss
hint: Compute ratio r = exp(new_logps - old_logps_detached). Form unclipped = r * adv_detached and clipped = clamp(r, 1-clip, 1+clip) * adv_detached. Return the negative mean of min(unclipped, clipped). Gradients should flow only through new_logps.
constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
